regime_context: Hong Kong's thematic rotation is narrowing: only 5 of 17 themes are eligible under the absolute-trend gate. The headline leader is Tech Hardware & Semis (eligible, trend, modest durability, low breadth), while Diversified Miners tops momentum rank but is ineligible and unscorable. No crowding flags. The detector's validated edge is drawdown avoidance for eligible themes; momentum ranks are a focus lens, not alpha. Macro headlines are dominated by AI tech, but that is coincident backdrop. All conviction is set low given the absence of scorable proxies and small track record.
emerging_watch: Monitor whether Diversified Miners (currently ineligible, rank 1, trend) becomes eligible under the absolute-trend gate and the score margin over Tech Hardware & Semis contracts further. That would be an early clue of a potential commodity-led handoff, but not confirmed until eligibility flips. Observable condition: Diversified Miners turns eligible before the end of August 2026.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: The theme is trending (Hurst) and eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which historically reduces drawdown risk. Despite low breadth (16.7%), the durable trend and lack of crowding suggest the upward leadership may persist. Momentum rank and macro AI headlines serve only as attention lenses, not return forecasts.
theses.dissent: Very low breadth—only 16.7% of constituents participating—means the rally is extremely narrow. If the few large-cap leaders falter, the entire theme could reverse sharply with no cushion from broader allocation.

falsifier.text: Tech Hardware & Semis breadth drops below 0.10 and its relative strength vs the Hang Seng turns negative over a rolling 10-day window before the 20-day horizon.

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
theses.thesis: Eligible under the gate, displaying full breadth (1.0) and the highest durability (0.75) among eligible themes. Although the Hurst tag is 'mixed' rather than pure trend, the robust participation and balance-sheet orientation suggest lower downside volatility in a sideways tape. The trend gate validates lower drawdown risk.
theses.dissent: The 'mixed' Hurst tag indicates no persistent directional bias; the theme may merely oscillate rather than deliver outperformance, even though drawdowns are capped. In a sharply risk-off move, its correlation to financials could bite.

falsifier.text: Conglomerates & Exchange breadth falls below 0.8 and its cumulative relative return vs the Hang Seng turns negative over the 20-day horizon.
